name: Logo Cloud: Checkerboard
summary: A bordered grid of customer or partner logos laid out as a checkerboard of tinted and transparent cells, with responsive columns and a hover and focus lift on each logo.
useWhen: Showing customers or partners as a grid of logos on a landing page
Needing a logo grid that stays tidy on phones, with two columns, and tints its cells with a theme colour
avoidWhen: The list is long and needs filtering; use a searchable data grid instead
You need a scrolling logo marquee rather than a fixed grid
